decision: Keep the first copy of each exact duplicate.
reason: Identical registry rows repeat the same patient information.

issue: gender spellings that are not a code
decision: Map spellings to F, M, or X; leave empty and unknown values missing.
reason: Different spellings represent the same categories, while empty and unknown values provide no recorded gender.

decision: Uppercase site codes and remove all spaces and hyphens.
reason: Codes such as n-01 and N01 refer to the same site.

decision: Replace 9999 with missing and use Int64.
reason: 9999 means the birth year was not recorded.

issue: weight column named wt_kg in visits_south.csv
decision: Rename wt_kg to weight_kg before stacking.
reason: Both columns contain weight in kg and must align when stacked.

issue: sbp sentinel 999 and readings outside 70 through 250
decision: Keep values from 70 through 250 inclusive; set all others to missing.
reason: 999 means not measured, and readings outside 70 through 250 violate the specified range.

issue: impossible and loosely written visit dates
decision: Keep only existing calendar dates written exactly as YYYY-MM-DD.
reason: Impossible dates and loosely written dates violate the required date format or calendar validity.

decision: Remove exact repeats, then keep the later reading for each patient and visit.
reason: Rechecks repeat a visit key, and the required rule retains the later measurement.
